description: logwatch: recent host logs — tail, grep, since, marks, sources, stats and subscriptions
author: Serg Parf and agent-bus contributors

tail.help: Last N retained lines, oldest first, unfiltered

grep.help: Search retained lines only when asked

since.help: Lines received within an age, not the date inside their text

mark.help: Mark the current history position; ring and marks do not survive restart

after.help: Retained lines strictly after a mark; expired marks are refused

sources.help: List watched files/journal units, exclusions, counts, last lines and errors

stats.help: Version, uptime, history capacity/fill, lines seen and dropped

sub.add.help: Text: sub add <target> [filter]; forward new matching lines, fold repeats for five minutes

args.name: target
args.help: Bus destination; you must manage it, or be this agent’s direct Owner/Maintainer

args.name: filter
args.help: Plain text or /regex/imsu; omitted matches all

sub.list.help: Text: sub list; show subscriptions, runtime counts and errors

help.help: Describe this agent and the help-config and help-secret asks

sources.help: Absolute file patterns and/or syslog; new files start at EOF

excludes.help: Absolute excluded file patterns; see guide for tail-all defaults

rescan_interval.help: Seconds between source rescans, a number from 0.05 to 86400

journal.help: List of exact unit names, or all; account must have journal read access
